Name: livipup's Dinos for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Need more dinos? Of course you do! With permission from livipup, I've  updated and rewritten their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4649]More Dinosaurs for More Animals or Adopt'nSkin[/url] to work as a standalone mod to add more dinos to your game! 

This mod includes 3 varieties of stegosaurus and a brachiosaurus. You can buy them at Marnie's and they live in coops, and they come in a variety of colors. These dinos will produce ancient seeds and dino eggs, and they'll produce the eggs slightly faster than the vanilla dinos. They also make little roaring sounds.

Enjoy!
